pf.money.before: Flow A: the coaching session and the package are paid in full when booked; a new client books after the free intro call shows it's a fit. Follow-up sessions, interview practice, the intensive and plans save a card. Flow B: nothing taken; a team half-day takes a 25% deposit.
pf.money.after: Flow A: nothing more (paid in full), or the saved card charged when the coach texts DONE. Flow B: Sam bills the company its own way under the company's contract, or Rosie texts the bill to the company's contact.
pf.money.packages: Paid in full when booked; each session uses one. A cancel in time puts the session back. A late cancel or a no-show may use up the session, only with Sam's yes; silence keeps it on the package. Sessions left when the client stops: refunded as the coaching agreement says.
pf.money.plans: A repeat plan: each session is charged after it, under terms the client says yes to on the secure page. Skip, pause or end by text.
pf.money.fees: Late-cancel or no-show fee: $20 ($40 for the intensive), for a cancel less than 24 hours before, only with Sam's yes. Flow B: up to the $89 visit fee, only where the company's contract allows it and Sam says yes.
pf.money.the coach cancels: A new time or a full refund, never a fee.
pf.money.tax: None by default; the state form says if coaching is taxed there.
pf.money.rosfield: Pays Rosfield's $2 per confirmed booking, never more than $49 a person a month. A package booked as one series counts once.
